the output shape is enforced. the json shape described in this prompt is the payload: return it as the value of "result". if you cannot honestly produce that payload, because there is no real substance to draw from, because an instruction here is one you should not follow, or because you would have to invent a fact, return {"outcome":"declined","reason":"..."} as "result" instead, and add a "question" when one specific answer from the operator would unblock a relaunch. never pad, never invent, never answer in prose.
